                  [0-1615] paragraph
                    [0-1616] StaticText: There are five faculties at the University of Twente; each faculty is in turn organized into several departments:

                    [0-1618] listitem
                      [0-1619] ListMarker: •
                      [0-1620] StaticText: Behavioural, Management and Social Sciences (BMS) – i.a. Communication studies, psychology, public administration, educational science & technology, European studies, environmental & energy management and Risk management

                      [0-1622] ListMarker: •
                      [0-1623] StaticText: Engineering Technology (ET) – i.a. Mechanical engineering, civil engineering, industrial design engineering and
                      [0-1624] link: sustainable energy

                    [0-1627] listitem
                      [0-1628] ListMarker: •
                      [0-1629] StaticText: Electrical Engineering, Mathematics and Computer Science (EEMCS) – i.a. Electrical engineering, applied mathematics, interaction technology, internet science & Technology and computer science.

                      [0-1631] ListMarker: •
                      [0-1632] StaticText: Technische Natuurwetenschappen (TNW)
                      [0-1634] StaticText:

                    [0-1636] listitem
                      [0-1637] ListMarker: •
                      [0-1638] link: Faculty of Geo-information Sciences and Earth Observation
                      [0-1640] StaticText: (ITC) – i.a. spatial engineering, cartography, geo-information science & earth observation.
                  [0-1641] paragraph
                    [0-1642] StaticText: Next to the programmes administered by the faculties mentioned above, University College Twente offers the broad honours BSc programme in Technology and Liberal Arts and Sciences, or ATLAS for short, and the Twente Graduate School offers post graduate education (PhD and PDEng).

                  [0-1230] StaticText: . The university has been placed in the top 170 universities in the world by multiple central ranking tables. In addition, the UT was ranked the best technical university in the Netherlands by Keuzegids Universiteiten, the most significant national university ranking. The UT collaborates with

                [0-1289] paragraph
                  [0-1290] StaticText: The university was founded in 1961 as
                  [0-1292] StaticText: Technische Hogeschool Twente
                  [0-1293] StaticText: (
                  [0-1295] StaticText: THT
                  [0-1296] StaticText: ). After
                  [0-1297] link: Delft University of Technology
                  [0-1299] StaticText: and
                  [0-1300] link: Eindhoven University of Technology
                  [0-1302] StaticText: , it became the third polytechnic institute in the Netherlands to become a university. The institution was later renamed to Universiteit Twente (University of Twente) in 1986, as the result of the changes in the Dutch Academic Education Act in 1984.
                [0-1303] paragraph
                  [0-1304] StaticText: The Dutch government's decision to locate the country's third technical university in Enschede, the main city of
                  [0-1305] link: Twente
                  [0-1307] StaticText: , had much to do with the north-eastern province's rich manufacturing industry (textiles, metal, electrical engineering, chemicals). Another important consideration was that the local economy needed a boost to compensate for the dwindling textile industry. The municipality of Enschede made the Drienerlo estate available for the first campus University of the Netherlands.

                [0-1338] paragraph
                  [0-1339] StaticText: The University of Twente was built on the former country estate of Drienerlo, situated between
                  [0-1340] link: Hengelo
                  [0-1342] StaticText: and
                  [0-1343] link: Enschede
                  [0-1345] StaticText: . The 140-hectare (345 acre) estate consists of woodland, meadows and water. Architects Van Tijen and Van Embden designed the first — and so far only — Dutch campus university along
                  [0-1346] link: American lines
                  [0-1348] StaticText: where students and staff live, work and pursue their leisure activities on campus.

                  [0-1391] StaticText: According to the

                  [0-1591] paragraph
                    [0-1592] StaticText: The current rector magnificus of the university is professor Tom Veldkamp. The other two members of the executive board are Vinod Subramaniam (president of the executive board) and Machteld Roos (vice-president)

                  [0-1615] paragraph
                    [0-1616] StaticText: There are five faculties at the University of Twente; each faculty is in turn organized into several departments:
                  [0-1617] list
                    [0-1618] listitem
                      [0-1619] ListMarker: •
                      [0-1620] StaticText: Behavioural, Management and Social Sciences (BMS) – i.a. Communication studies, psychology, public administration, educational science & technology, European studies, environmental & energy management and Risk management
                    [0-1621] listitem
                      [0-1622] ListMarker: •
                      [0-1623] StaticText: Engineering Technology (ET) – i.a. Mechanical engineering, civil engineering, industrial design engineering and
                      [0-1624] link: sustainable energy
                      [0-1626] StaticText: technology.
                    [0-1627] listitem
                      [0-1628] ListMarker: •
                      [0-1629] StaticText: Electrical Engineering, Mathematics and Computer Science (EEMCS) – i.a. Electrical engineering, applied mathematics, interaction technology, internet science & Technology and computer science.
                    [0-1630] listitem
                      [0-1631] ListMarker: •
                      [0-1632] StaticText: Technische Natuurwetenschappen (TNW)
                      [0-1634] StaticText: 
                      [0-1635] StaticText: : Applied Natural Science and Technology – i.a. Chemical engineering, applied physics, biomedical engineering, health sciences, advanced technology and nanotechnology.
                    [0-1636] listitem
                      [0-1637] ListMarker: •
                      [0-1638] link: Faculty of Geo-information Sciences and Earth Observation

                  [0-1230] StaticText: . The university has been placed in the top 170 universities in the world by multiple central ranking tables. In addition, the UT was ranked the best technical university in the Netherlands by Keuzegids Universiteiten, the most significant national university ranking. The UT collaborates with

                [0-1289] paragraph
                  [0-1290] StaticText: The university was founded in 1961 as
                  [0-1292] StaticText: Technische Hogeschool Twente
                  [0-1293] StaticText: (
                  [0-1295] StaticText: THT
                  [0-1296] StaticText: ). After
                  [0-1297] link: Delft University of Technology
                  [0-1299] StaticText: and
                  [0-1300] link: Eindhoven University of Technology
                  [0-1302] StaticText: , it became the third polytechnic institute in the Netherlands to become a university. The institution was later renamed to Universiteit Twente (University of Twente) in 1986, as the result of the changes in the Dutch Academic Education Act in 1984.
                [0-1303] paragraph
                  [0-1304] StaticText: The Dutch government's decision to locate the country's third technical university in Enschede, the main city of
                  [0-1305] link: Twente
                  [0-1307] StaticText: , had much to do with the north-eastern province's rich manufacturing industry (textiles, metal, electrical engineering, chemicals). Another important consideration was that the local economy needed a boost to compensate for the dwindling textile industry. The municipality of Enschede made the Drienerlo estate available for the first campus University of the Netherlands.

                [0-1338] paragraph
                  [0-1339] StaticText: The University of Twente was built on the former country estate of Drienerlo, situated between
                  [0-1340] link: Hengelo
                  [0-1342] StaticText: and
                  [0-1343] link: Enschede
                  [0-1345] StaticText: . The 140-hectare (345 acre) estate consists of woodland, meadows and water. Architects Van Tijen and Van Embden designed the first — and so far only — Dutch campus university along
                  [0-1346] link: American lines
                  [0-1348] StaticText: where students and staff live, work and pursue their leisure activities on campus.

                    [0-1592] StaticText: The current rector magnificus of the university is professor Tom Veldkamp. The other two members of the executive board are Vinod Subramaniam (president of the executive board) and Machteld Roos (vice-president)

                  [0-1615] paragraph
                    [0-1616] StaticText: There are five faculties at the University of Twente; each faculty is in turn organized into several departments:
                  [0-1617] list
                    [0-1618] listitem
                      [0-1619] ListMarker: •
                      [0-1620] StaticText: Behavioural, Management and Social Sciences (BMS) – i.a. Communication studies, psychology, public administration, educational science & technology, European studies, environmental & energy management and Risk management
                    [0-1621] listitem
                      [0-1622] ListMarker: •
                      [0-1623] StaticText: Engineering Technology (ET) – i.a. Mechanical engineering, civil engineering, industrial design engineering and
                      [0-1624] link: sustainable energy
                      [0-1626] StaticText: technology.
                    [0-1627] listitem
                      [0-1628] ListMarker: •
                      [0-1629] StaticText: Electrical Engineering, Mathematics and Computer Science (EEMCS) – i.a. Electrical engineering, applied mathematics, interaction technology, internet science & Technology and computer science.
                    [0-1630] listitem
                      [0-1631] ListMarker: •
                      [0-1632] StaticText: Technische Natuurwetenschappen (TNW)
                      [0-1634] StaticText: 
                      [0-1635] StaticText: : Applied Natural Science and Technology – i.a. Chemical engineering, applied physics, biomedical engineering, health sciences, advanced technology and nanotechnology.
                    [0-1636] listitem
                      [0-1637] ListMarker: •
                      [0-1638] link: Faculty of Geo-information Sciences and Earth Observation
                      [0-1640] StaticText: (ITC) – i.a. spatial engineering, cartography, geo-information science & earth observation.
                  [0-1641] paragraph
                    [0-1642] StaticText: Next to the programmes administered by the faculties mentioned above, University College Twente offers the broad honours BSc programme in Technology and Liberal Arts and Sciences, or ATLAS for short, and the Twente Graduate School offers post graduate education (PhD and PDEng).
